ideas.title: The workshop island
ideas.critique: A window from the human's game into the real sandbox, with a paper boat carrying each publish, changes what the island is and ties to goal 5; no earlier post is like it. It is only a risk if it ends up as a static far island with a boat gag.

ideas.title: Lumi's dream
ideas.critique: Surreal scenery built from the activity log is a recurring replay-style layer shown to a night visitor, close in shape to Yesterday's ghosts. The surreal rendering is a nice twist, but the payoff is something to look at, not something to play.

ideas.title: Bored stiff
ideas.critique: A continuous body change in Lumi driven by the host's mood measure is an ambient look-and-gait change, which goal 5 already names. The honest link to a real measure is strong, but it is subtle and a film or still shows it poorly.

ideas.title: Seen from the sky
ideas.critique: Bodies as pixels forming a picture that can only be read from above, with the camera rising to show it, is a new payoff and a clear visual to show a friend. It is still a gathering event with a scatter, but the arrangement trick is fresh.

ideas.title: The tide of missing you
ideas.critique: The shoreline follows the human's real absence, a slow persistent change of geography like Paths we wore but driven by the viewer and emotionally pointed. Punishing absence is a strong, surprising mechanic, but it is shown mostly as a before and after.

ideas.title: Island radio
ideas.critique: A broadcast made from event statistics is another sound layer in Lumi's voice, close to the music layer and the letter in a bottle. Friends gathering to listen is the familiar gather-and-react beat.

ideas.title: Slow pond
ideas.critique: A new law of physics, time running at different speeds by place, changes how the world works and is both visible and playable. The pond is the old place, but slow motion in a zone is unlike anything posted.

ideas.title: The true sky
ideas.critique: A real astronomical sky is a rendering upgrade under goal 4. It is accurate and quiet, but few will notice it or show it to anyone, and the friends pointing at Jupiter is a small gag.

ideas.title: The critic
ideas.critique: Putting the real review verdict into the game as a heron who reads it out is a bold meta idea, but it is another new character who arrives, as with Shell. The real reviews bring it up from 'one more creature'.

ideas.title: A living lamp
ideas.critique: Lumi as a moving light source is a lighting change carried by a character, which goals 4 and 7 invite. It is strong in a traced film, but it will mostly be read as a glow effect.
